description: Read-only indexed history of payload values used when starting a specific XRC-729 OSTC entry step. Reads Explorer PGRO through the MCP gateway only, selects the first matching entry-step receipt per owner/session, and returns compact scalar value statistics for UI pickers.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

ostcId.description: Orchestration step contract id for the XDaLa workflow.

owner.description: EVM address of the XDaLa session owner or relevant account.

stepId.description: Canonical XDaLa step id used by Workbench/session-start requests.

windowHours.description: Value for the window hours parameter.

xrc729Address.description: Value for the xrc729 address parameter.

name: get_xdala_start_payload_history

data.description: Structured result data returned by the XGR MCP gateway.

title: Get XDaLa start payload history
